name: sql_auto_complete
description: Return ranked autocomplete suggestions for a partial SQL string using the VS-Code-derived fuzzy matcher. Used by the DuckDB CLI for Tab-completion; you can also call it directly in SQL. With the [v1.5 activation fix](https://github.com/Query-farm/fuzzycomplete/commit/8b89b19bbed0c7338a2a5e1dfc08eea88290e0ee), loading fuzzycomplete replaces the preloaded stock provider. Older build `9746833` leaves the stock provider active when autocomplete is already loaded.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: The partial SQL text the user has typed. Suggestions are ranked by fuzzy match score against keywords and identifiers (databases, schemas, tables, columns) currently visible to the session.

examples.description: Complete a SQL keyword — the top suggestion for `SEL` is `SELECT`.
Suggest a table name after `FROM` — the completer walks every attached database and schema in the search path.
Substring + camelCase matching — typing `gnst` finds `getNotificationStatus` even though it isn't a prefix.
examples.code:
SELECT suggestion
FROM sql_auto_complete('SELECT * FROM gnst');
